findings.text: It is highly recommended to create a dedicated workspace for managing the OAuth2 application.
findings.quote: It is **highly recommended** you create a workspace for the purpose of managing the OAuth2 Application, as each admin user will have access.

findings.text: Create a new OAuth2 application in the Linear settings.
findings.quote: Create a new [OAuth2 Application](https://linear.app/settings/api/applications/new) and configure the redirect callback URLs to your application.

findings.text: Access tokens are valid for 24 hours.
findings.quote: The access token is valid for 24 hours and will need to be refreshed when it expires.

findings.text: Refresh token requests have a 30-minute grace period for retries.
findings.quote: Requests to consume a refresh token and obtain a new one have a 30-minute grace period to allow for network errors.

findings.text: OAuth2 apps can have up to 1000 active client credentials tokens in parallel.
findings.quote: OAuth2 apps can have up to 1000 active client credentials tokens in parallel, provided each token uses the same scopes.

findings.text: Client credentials tokens are valid for 30 days.
findings.quote: The token generated using this grant type will be an `app` actor token that has access to all public teams in the workspace and is valid for 30 days.

findings.text: The token field must not be combined with legacy fields during revocation.
findings.quote: The `token` field must not be combined with legacy fields.

findings.text: Linear supports two authentication modes: user-based actor or app-based actor.
findings.quote: Linear also supports an alternative authentication method with **OAuth Actor Authorization** – when authenticating this way the user will instead authorize installing the app within the workspace, actions performed with the received OAuth token will come from the app itself.

findings.text: To enable actor authorization, add the actor=app parameter to the OAuth authorization URL.
findings.quote: To enable the actor authorization, add `actor=app` parameter to your [OAuth authorization URL](https://linear.app/developers/oauth-2-0-authentication#redirect-user-access-requests-to-linear).

findings.text: The actor=application mode is deprecated.
findings.quote: Note, we previously supported a similar `actor=application` as a mode – this was deprecated in favor of the behavior in `actor=app`.

findings.text: OAuth apps are limited to 5,000 requests per hour per user.

findings.text: The maximum complexity for a single query is 10,000 points.
findings.quote: We also enforce a maximum complexity of a single query at any time to 10,000 points.

findings.text: Queries exceeding the maximum complexity of 10,000 points will be rejected.
findings.quote: We also enforce a maximum complexity of a single query at any time to 10,000 points. Your query will always get rejected if it exceeds that.
